descriptions.text: Dwight. Sparkling Unicorn. Level 87 Enchanter. One of two members of Team Sparkles. I bet you already know what a unicorn is. A sparkling unicorn is pretty much the same thing, but they sparkle because they have even more magic permeating them. Their horns are quite valuable to certain parties, so if you kill him, it's recommended to grab the horn as quickly as possible. Most unicorns are regarded for their beauty and their grace and their childlike innocence. They're generally known for their overly gentle manner. But not Dwight. Dwight is known for being a complete prick. He's the type of guy who would call the police on a kid setting up a lemonade stand. He's the type of guy who, at the office pizza party, would take three pieces, knowing there's not enough to go around.

recap.text: Dwight finishes ahead of the Royal Court of Princess Donut in the first heat. He uses a cannon in a vine-covered bush to blow up Girth the Trouble. A drunk Dwight drives his horn through a disc jockey's face. He wins Heat Five by riding his unicorn over a factory roof. Crawler Donut removes Dwight's head and puts his horn in her inventory.

beats.headline: Team Sparkles goes past
beats.text: Team Sparkles stops in the road just long enough to be rude, Dwight and Lucienne both, and then goes straight over the top of the trailer and the wrecked van when the food truck's horn spooks their mount. In the same stretch of track Crawler Carl works out what this floor is actually for, which is thinning out the NPCs who have woken up, and Elle gets through an awkward meeting with a fan. The Royal Court of Princess Donut finishes the first heat seventh of nine, having spent most of it towing team Free Love home. Dwight finished ahead of them. Dwight would want that mentioned.
beats.gist: Team Sparkles is rude to Dwight and Lucienne before their mount spooks and jumps a trailer.

beats.headline: A cannon out of the bush
beats.text: Green light. A tank barrel slides out of the side of Team Sparkles' pile of vines and fires point blank into the yellow Chevy Bel Air of Girth the Trouble, whose guck elemental had spent the countdown shouting at the unicorn about his horn and his mother. The car goes straight up like a rocket and comes down burning in the ditch. The barrel peels back like something in a cartoon. Girth the Trouble is eliminated. Dwight tells everyone how girlie that was. Then the bush leaves.
beats.gist: A tank barrel fires from a bush into a yellow Chevy Bel Air, eliminating Girth the Trouble.

beats.headline: The cannon again, at the line
beats.text: Subject comes up on the left in the final seconds with the cannon hanging out of the slime-covered bush and fires across the finish, into the food truck and the Lady Dominators' GTO alike. All three vehicles go over the line together, airborne. The vine survives, smouldering; so do Dwight and Lucienne, whose helmet is cracked. Dwight wants to see everyone cry, and promises that everyone is dead next race and will be shot first. Then the vine limps into the garage marked 2.
beats.gist: Dwight fires a cannon from a slime-covered bush into a food truck and a GTO.

beats.headline: Rescued by people he was rude to
beats.text: Team Sparkles is still in this race, which by every reasonable projection it should not be. Jasha and Radoslav of team Free Love found Dwight spinning in circles just outside the exit and dragged him in. I record outcomes rather than motives, so I will confine myself to the facts: the two who did it are the two whose van he once drove straight over.
beats.gist: Jasha and Radoslav of team Free Love drag Dwight into the exit after he spins in circles.

beats.headline: The horn and the disc jockey
beats.text: The Lollipop, packed to the walls, Crawler Carl full of bard potions and climbing onto a stage to sing his way into a guild. Dwight is drunk at the front of the room. As the pair of them get up there he drives his horn through the disc jockey's face. The disc jockey had been shouting at him. Beyond that there was no faction in it, nothing at stake and nothing to gain. He simply did it, in a room already full of armed strangers looking for a reason.
beats.gist: Dwight drives his horn through a disc jockey's face in the packed Lollipop.

beats.headline: One drunk unicorn, one wrecked duet
beats.text: He follows it by hurling the dead disc jockey at Crawler Carl and Crawler Donut, misses, and hits a demon of team Yokai, which draws in the Minister of Blood-Letting and his skeletons and then most of the floor. Carl's allies spend the entire song trying to keep the teams in that room from murdering each other. On the last line of the thing Crawler Donut is knocked flat by a paralysed kappa and loses the entry she had just sung for. Crawler Carl gets in alone. One drunk unicorn, one wrecked duet, one guild place where there should have been two.
beats.gist: Dwight hurls a dead disc jockey at Carl and Donut, hitting a Yokai demon instead.

beats.headline: Over the roof
beats.text: Heat Five, first place: Team Sparkles, which is to say one drunk unicorn who sat motionless on the starting line while everyone else drove in. According to Jasha, relayed by Osvaldo, he then rode up the factory wall, crossed the roof and dropped off at the finish without entering the building. He was the only racer to work out that this was allowed. Osvaldo calls it cheating. The rules do not, and the rules are the ones keeping score.
beats.gist: Dwight is a drunk unicorn who wins Heat Five by riding over the factory roof.

beats.headline: Sober, with a missile launcher
beats.text: Dwight arrives at the final heat awake and sober, which is noted. His vine is towing a wheeled cart with a spinning missile launcher on it, which he cannot fire until he clears the low ceiling of the starting blocks. His navigation hologram has been programmed to look and sound exactly like the late Lucienne, and it tells Crawler Carl his low-tier unit is finished. Dwight tells Carl he will suffer as he dies. Carl rolls up the window.
beats.gist: Dwight arrives awake and sober with a vine towing a wheeled cart and a spinning missile launcher.

beats.headline: One swipe at the starting line
beats.text: Team One, Team Sparkles, has been eliminated. The light turned green and the timed hole punch opened the shield, the vine-killing potion killed the vine, and a second potion fried the navigation that looked like Lucienne. Before Osvaldo's gnu had recovered from Dwight's own cannon, Crawler Donut was through the window and had removed his head. His horn is now in her inventory. The missile cart never launched. The official notification reads: because, holy shit, that was pretty badass. It stands.
beats.gist: Donut removes Dwight's head and takes his horn after a potion fries the Lucienne-like navigation.
